name: ChatGPT memory
desc: ChatGPT keeps standing facts across separate chats.
desc_zh: 跨对话记住你的固定信息，也能随时让它忘掉。
solves: Re-explaining your role and preferences at the start of every session. Memory carries them forward — and deleting the chat does not delete them.
solves_zh: 每次开新对话都要重讲一遍身份和偏好。记忆替你带过去——但删掉对话并不会删掉它记的东西。
best_for: You use it as a standing assistant and have stopped wanting to repeat who you are.
best_for_zh: 你把它当长期助手用，已经不想反复交代自己是谁了。
notes: 集成在 ChatGPT 内的能力。来源：https://openai.com/index/memory-and-new-controls-for-chatgpt/
